Class TextInputSource

Namespace: osu.Framework.Input
Assembly: osu.Framework.dll

A source from which we can retrieve user text input. Generally hides a native implementation from the game framework.

Methods

Activate(TextInputProperties, RectangleF)

Activates this osu.Framework.Input.TextInputSource. User text input can be acquired through osu.Framework.Input.TextInputSource.OnTextInput, osu.Framework.Input.TextInputSource.OnImeComposition and osu.Framework.Input.TextInputSource.OnImeResult.

public void Activate(TextInputProperties properties, RectangleF imeRectangle)

Parameters

properties TextInputProperties

A set of properties to consider during this text input session.

imeRectangle RectangleF

Rough location of where the text will be input, so the native implementation can adjust virtual keyboards and IME popups.

Remarks

Each osu.Framework.Input.TextInputSource.Activate(osu.Framework.Input.TextInputProperties,osu.Framework.Graphics.Primitives.RectangleF) must be followed by a osu.Framework.Input.TextInputSource.Deactivate.

ActivateTextInput(TextInputProperties)

Activates the native implementation that provides text input. Should be overriden per-platform.

protected virtual void ActivateTextInput(TextInputProperties properties)

Parameters

properties TextInputProperties

A set of properties to consider during this text input session.

Remarks

An active native implementation should call osu.Framework.Input.TextInputSource.TriggerTextInput(System.String) on new text input and forward IME composition events through osu.Framework.Input.TextInputSource.TriggerImeComposition(System.String,System.Int32,System.Int32) and osu.Framework.Input.TextInputSource.TriggerImeResult(System.String).

Deactivate()

Deactivates this osu.Framework.Input.TextInputSource.

public void Deactivate()

Remarks

Should be called once text input is no longer needed. Each osu.Framework.Input.TextInputSource.Deactivate must be preceded by an osu.Framework.Input.TextInputSource.Activate(osu.Framework.Input.TextInputProperties,osu.Framework.Graphics.Primitives.RectangleF).

DeactivateTextInput()

Deactivates the native implementation that provides text input. Should be overriden per-platform.

protected virtual void DeactivateTextInput()

EnsureActivated(TextInputProperties, RectangleF?)

Ensures that the native implementation that retrieves user text input is activated and that the user can start entering text.

public void EnsureActivated(TextInputProperties properties, RectangleF? imeRectangle = null)

Parameters

properties TextInputProperties

A set of properties to consider during this text input session.

imeRectangle RectangleF?

Rough location of where the text will be input, so the native implementation can adjust virtual keyboards and IME popups. Can be null to avoid changing the IME rectangle.

EnsureTextInputActivated(TextInputProperties)

Ensures that the native implementation that retrieves user text input is activated and that the user can start entering text.

protected virtual void EnsureTextInputActivated(TextInputProperties properties)

Parameters

properties TextInputProperties

A set of properties to consider during this text input session.

Remarks

Only called if the native implementation has been activated with osu.Framework.Input.TextInputSource.Activate(osu.Framework.Input.TextInputProperties,osu.Framework.Graphics.Primitives.RectangleF).
